==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|free-style}}

===Etymology===
From {{compound|en|free|style}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfɹiːˌstaɪl/}}
* ''US:'' {{IPA|en|/fɹiˌstaɪəl/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-freestyle.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|sports}} A sports event where [[competitor]]s can choose their own method of [[participation]].
## {{lb|en|swimming}} A [[swimming]] [[event]] in which the [[contestant]]s may [[choose]] any [[stroke]].
### {{lb|en|swimming|by extension}} The swimming [[stroke]] commonly referred to as the [[front crawl]] or the [[Australian crawl]].
## {{lb|en|skiing}} A [[cross-country skiing]] event in which the [[competitor]]s may choose any style of skiing.
### {{lb|en|skiing|by extension}} The skiing style commonly referred to as [[skating]].
## {{lb|en|wrestling}} A style of [[wrestling]] in which any non-[[injurious]] [[hold]]s are [[permitted]].
# {{lb|en|music}} A form of [[rapping]] in which the [[emcee]] makes up [[lyric]]s while performing.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2014|author=Michael W. Waters|title=Freestyle: Reflections on Faith, Family, Justice, and Pop Culture|publisher=Fresh Air Books|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QZ2aAgAAQBAJ&pg=PT16&dq=%22freestyle%22&hl=&cd=10&source=gbs_api#v=onepage&q=%22freestyle%22&f=false|isbn=9781935205197|text=In the world of hip hop, many '''freestyle''' artists have been known to speak, “Check one, check two!” into the microphone. The phrasing serves two purposes: (1) to put the '''freestyle''' artist on rhythm with the beat and (2) {{...}}}}
# {{lb|en|by extension|attributive}} Anything done in an improvised or unrestricted way.
# {{lb|en|music genre}} {{ellipsis of|en|Latin freestyle|addl=a form of [[electronic dance music]]}}.
#* {{quote-web|en|url=https://www.villagevoice.com/2012/03/02/a-quick-primer-on-freestyle-1980s-dancepops-most-underheralded-genre/|title=A Quick Primer On Freestyle: 1980s Dancepop's Most Underheralded Genre|date=2012-03-02|author=Nick Minichino|work=The Village Voice|passage=A not always visibly but nevertheless significantly Latin music, '''freestyle''' originated alongside hip-hop in the Bronx and achieved a quicker yet more fleeting commercial success. The style’s similarities to contemporaneous R&B and hi-NRG endeared it to pop radio programmers, {{...}}|accessdate=16 November 2022|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20221116233952/https://www.villagevoice.com/2012/03/02/a-quick-primer-on-freestyle-1980s-dancepops-most-underheralded-genre/|archivedate=16 November 2022}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|intransitive|especially in [[rap music]]}} To [[improvise]] one's own style; to [[ad-lib]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2016|author=Jensen Karp|title=Kanye West Owes Me $300: And Other True Stories from a White Rapper Who Almost Made It Big|publisher=Crown|isbn=9780553448160|page=47|pageurl=https://books.google.com/books?id=PZWTCgAAQBAJ&pg=PA47&dq=%22freestyled%22&hl=&cd=3&source=gbs_api#v=onepage&q=%22freestyled%22&f=false|text=And just hours after the famous golfer died in an airplane accident, I '''freestyled''' to a less talented rival, “Stop now before you get hurt / Your whole style should never take flight like Payne Stewart.”}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[improvise]] one's dance moves; dance freely.
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[improvise]] something in an unrestricted way.
